D8.note: Lexicon import pins (LEXICON SPEC section 3). Source POLICY is decided; two of the three artifacts have not landed yet. A pin is a content digest of a fetched dump, not a label: 'latest stable' and 'current' resolve to a different artifact next week, so they name a fetch rule, not an input. KICKOFF 7.5 forbids a live pull during a run for the same mechanical reason - an unpinned source cannot hash cleanly, so the seed hash keying every verdict would mean nothing. Record each artifact with `python cli.py pin <source> --path ...` when it lands.
